reader_summary.overview: Today, we cover the industrial conglomerate AMETEK. This is one of eight companies that Mark Leonard and his team at Constellation Software studied as they built their own empire. And it's one well worthy of a discussion as you'll hear.

key_points.text: To break down AMETEK, I'm joined by Nael Fakhry, Co-CIO of the Osterweis Capital Management Growth and Income Strategy.
Nael has spent a significant amount of time around AMETEK from the early 2000s until today.
Please enjoy this breakdown on AMETEK.
